visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As screens permeate every home, both teenagers and adults face how online personas alter who they are behind closed doors.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Directed by Jason Reitman, this comedy-drama tracks a group of high school students and their parents as the internet reshapes their daily communication, self-image, and romantic lives.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful and emotionally grounded; an unhurried, observant ensemble drama suited for solitary or family viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Reitman examines modern digital intimacy with a steady, thoughtful balance of domestic comedy and emotional consequence across multiple generations.
